segments.he: זוֹ וְאֵין צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר זוֹ קָתָנֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: In the latter clause, the tanna «teaches» the mishna employing the style: «This, and it is unnecessary to say that,» i.e., the cases are arranged with each case more obvious than the one that preceded it.

moves.summary: the latter clause uses 'this, and needless to say that'
moves.about: the liability clause is arranged 'this, and needless to say that'
